Supreme Court questions drug price caps beyond cancer medicines

The Supreme Court of India has questioned why drug price caps, currently applied to cancer medicines, cannot be extended to other essential drugs. Following the court's push, the central government has agreed to cap profit margins on cancer drugs at 30%.
